subject: NyxCloud pilot onramp: recap & proposed milestones
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sara Black <sara.black@nyxcloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: NyxCloud pilot onramp: recap & proposed milestones

Hi Sara — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap of what we heard and a tight set of next steps so everyone is aligned. Please flag anything we missed.

Pain points you described
- User-facing latency spikes when traffic bursts above 60k qps; p95 sometimes >300ms.
- Cost unpredictability with current self-hosted inference and friction operating multiple model variants.
- Data residency requirement for EU-sourced telemetry and audit logs for compliance.

Goals for the pilot
- Validate Redwood Dedicated for production throughput: handle steady 30k qpm and absorb 3x burst.
- Achieve p95 < 150ms for the core chat flow at target load.
- Confirm integration of Nyx SSO + VPC peering and log forwarding to your SIEM.
- Produce a clear runbook and unit economics for scale.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level)
1) Pilot scope signoff — scope doc and success criteria (owner: Sara / NyxCloud) — target by 2027-03-22
2) Environment provisioning — VPC peering, SSO test account, sample dataset ingest (owner: Redwood infra: Monica) — target start 2027-03-24; complete by 2027-03-31
3) Baseline run & stress tests — run two-week POC on Dedicated capacity (owner: NyxCloud + Redwood) — 2027-04-01 to 2027-04-14
4) Quality & cost evaluation — shared eval report and frank feedback session (owner: NyxCloud stakeholders + Nikhil) — target 2027-04-18
5) Contract + procurement — finalize terms and go/no-go decision (owner: NyxCloud procurement) — target signature by 2027-05-02

Stakeholders (so we’re clear on who to loop in)
- NyxCloud: Sara Black (platform lead), Michelle Foster (security/compliance), procurement@nyxcloud.com
- Redwood: Nikhil Sharma (sales lead), Monica Patel (solutions engineer), Ben Carter (customer success)

Immediate asks from Redwood
- Sara: confirm the success criteria (KPIs above) and the procurement contact to include on the MAP.
- NyxCloud ops: share a non-prod VPC CIDR and test account for SSO early this week if available.

Attachments I’m including: Redwood SOC 2 report (redwood_soc2_report_2026.pdf), a draft SOW tailored to the pilot (nyxcloud_draft_sow_2027.docx).

I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for a 30-minute scope signoff next Tuesday (2027-03-22). Thanks again — felt like strong alignment on outcomes and a realistic plan to validate quickly.

— Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
From: Sara Black <sara.black@nyxcloud.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NyxCloud pilot onramp: recap & proposed milestones

Thanks Nikhil — appreciate the crisp recap. Confirming the MAP looks good overall. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: can we add a soft threshold for inference error rate (<1% for core intents) as part of the quality checks?
- Timeline: procurement has an internal review window. Looping in procurement@nyxcloud.com (copied here) — Michelle will introduce the designated procurement owner.

Also: for capacity pricing we’re highly interested in both Dedicated (reserved pool) and a hybrid approach (hosted baseline + burst to Dedicated). Can Redwood share a short pricing summary for both options?

On the signoff meeting, I can do 2027-03-22 at 10:00 PT — I’ll confirm in a calendar invite once procurement is on the thread.

Sara Black

sara.black@nyxcloud.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Black <sara.black@nyxcloud.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NyxCloud pilot onramp: recap & proposed milestones — pricing note

Hi Sara — quick pricing note to help procurement evaluate options. Attaching a short slide deck with pricing examples (dedicated_pricing_slides.pdf). Highlights below:

- Dedicated reserved pool: monthly commit starting at $45k/month for a 2x baseline capacity (recommended for predictable latency & lower per-token cost).
- Hybrid (hosted baseline + Dedicated burst): lower upfront commit, pay-as-you-burst pricing for Dedicated capacity; expected 15–25% higher unit cost but lower committed spend.
- We can provide a 60-day pilot pricing waiver for the evaluation phase (limited to the pilot scope and up to the agreed token/throughput caps).

Next steps from Redwood ops perspective
- Monica will provision a staging VPC peering template and share terraform snippets by 2027-03-24.
- Ben will prepare an onboarding checklist and runbook for the POC start.

Link to the pricing doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cPricingSlides

Attachments: dedicated_pricing_slides.pdf

— Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Sara Black <sara.black@nyxcloud.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nyxcloud.com, Michelle Foster <michelle.foster@nyxcloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 12:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NyxCloud pilot onramp: recap & proposed milestones

Appreciate the quick turn, Monica — that pricing summary helps a lot. Michelle, looping you and procurement@nyxcloud.com — can you confirm the internal approval window (procurement lead and legal)?

Confirmed: 2027-03-22 10:00 PT for the scope signoff call (I’ll send invite). Owners & tentative dates look good from my side — we’ll try to accelerate the procurement review but anticipate a 10–14 business day cycle after SOW review.

Thanks team — moving to calendar.

— Sara
snippet: Recap of NyxCloud call, pain points (latency, cost, data residency), proposed milestones and owners; pricing ask and next steps.
